VOC1.label: Product quality feedback

VOC1.1.label: Positive product quality feedback
VOC1.1.description: Customer expresses satisfaction or praise specifically about product quality or reliability.

VOC1.2.label: Negative product quality feedback
VOC1.2.description: Customer expresses disappointment, frustration, or criticism about product quality or reliability.

VOC1.3.label: Specific product defect or reliability concern raised
VOC1.3.description: Customer describes a concrete defect, bug, or reliability problem as part of their feedback.

VOC1.description: Customer shares explicit feedback about the quality, reliability, or performance of the product.

VOC2.label: Service experience feedback

VOC2.1.label: Positive service experience feedback
VOC2.1.description: Customer praises the support experience: agent quality, resolution speed, or overall service.

VOC2.2.label: Negative service experience feedback
VOC2.2.description: Customer criticises the support experience: slow resolution, poor agent interaction, or frustrating process.

VOC2.3.label: Channel or accessibility feedback
VOC2.3.description: Customer gives feedback specifically about the support channel, wait times, or accessibility.

VOC2.description: Customer shares feedback about their experience with the support or service process, distinct from the product itself.

VOC3.label: Price and value feedback

VOC3.1.label: Price too high or poor value perception
VOC3.1.description: Customer expresses that the price is too high or does not justify the value received.

VOC3.2.label: Good value or fair pricing sentiment
VOC3.2.description: Customer indicates they feel the product is good value or fairly priced.

VOC3.3.label: Pricing structure confusion or concern
VOC3.3.description: Customer is confused by the pricing model, tier structure, or add-on charges.

VOC3.description: Customer shares views about whether the product or service represents good value for money.

VOC4.label: Competitor comparison

VOC4.1.label: Competitor mentioned positively or as superior
VOC4.1.description: Customer references a competitor as doing something better or as a reason to switch.

VOC4.2.label: Competitor mentioned neutrally for comparison
VOC4.2.description: Customer references a competitor for context without expressing clear preference.

VOC4.3.label: Switching intent expressed
VOC4.3.description: Customer explicitly states they are considering switching to a competitor or have already decided to leave.

VOC4.description: Customer mentions a competitor product or service, either positively or negatively.

VOC5.label: Feature request or improvement suggestion

VOC5.1.label: New feature requested
VOC5.1.description: Customer describes a capability they want that does not currently exist.

VOC5.2.label: Enhancement to existing feature requested
VOC5.2.description: Customer wants an existing feature to work differently, be more powerful, or be easier to use.

VOC5.3.label: Integration or ecosystem request
VOC5.3.description: Customer requests integration with a specific third-party tool or platform.

VOC5.4.label: Process or policy improvement suggestion
VOC5.4.description: Customer suggests an improvement to a company process, policy, or the support experience itself.

VOC5.description: Customer explicitly or implicitly requests a new feature, enhancement, or change to the product.

VOC6.label: Unmet need or capability gap

VOC6.1.label: Use case not supported by product
VOC6.1.description: Customer describes a valid use case that the product cannot currently support.

VOC6.2.label: Workflow or productivity gap
VOC6.2.description: Customer highlights a gap in their workflow that the product does not address.

VOC6.3.label: Content or information resource gap
VOC6.3.description: Customer cannot find documentation, training material, or information they need.

VOC6.description: Customer reveals a need their current product or service is not meeting, which may represent an opportunity to expand usage or address a gap.

VOC7.label: Positive endorsement

VOC7.1.label: Unprompted praise of agent or team
VOC7.1.description: Customer explicitly praises a specific agent, team, or member of staff by name or description.

VOC7.2.label: Would recommend or has already recommended
VOC7.2.description: Customer states they have recommended or would recommend the product to others.

VOC7.3.label: General product satisfaction
VOC7.3.description: Customer expresses broad satisfaction with the product without a specific trigger.

VOC7.description: Customer proactively expresses praise, recommends the product, or signals strong loyalty.

VOC8.label: Loyalty and churn signal

VOC8.1.label: Intent to renew or expand usage
VOC8.1.description: Customer mentions plans to renew their subscription, upgrade, or expand usage.

VOC8.2.label: Churn or cancellation intent
VOC8.2.description: Customer explicitly or strongly implicitly signals intent to cancel or not renew.

VOC8.3.label: Long-term loyalty signal
VOC8.3.description: Customer mentions how long they have been a customer, or expresses a long-term relationship with the brand.

VOC8.description: Customer reveals signals about their long-term intent to stay or leave.
